measurementSemantics: Request sequence/identity links phases without persisting bodies, capabilities, names or private save data. Client start/resume stamps are observations, not assertions about a frozen request or response envelope.

Request interval is send-start vicinity through coroutine resume, including scheduling and opt-in observation overhead. Decode, strict parser/validator and synchronous application/callback are separate phases; later UI Toolkit layout/render needs actual native capture.

All original parser functions, exact-authority joins, stale-generation guard, single-flight request logic and gameplay commands remain on their existing paths. This diff does not add asynchronous parsing or alter validators.

Telemetry is opt-in under the exact -studioAutoEvidence flag used by the native runner, bounded to 2048 request records and 32 synchronous phases per record. Dropped requests remain counted and must be disclosed; pending/failed/scoped-but-not-rendered records are not successful latency samples.

Frame metrics apply to explicit timestamped sample. Later route observations captured through application Quit are separate from that frame window. applicationQuitCapture is a final-write witness; root native report must additionally establish actual UI Quit and clean HID input.

Authority continuity is runtime/session/transport/poll continuity, not unchanged revision/digest or a proof of the expected late-world fixture. Dynamic advances can preserve session continuity; classify stable versus action windows from stamps/native trace and bind expected world externally.

Memory before/after remains sample-window observations including measurement structures, not maximum live heap, leak proof, allocation rate or process-wide peak. GC counters count collections, not pause durations.

Frame report complete and captured-through-quit denote completed observations, not threshold acceptance. Missing counters, dropped requests, failures and frame discontinuity remain explicit qualifications.
